title: ynh check --calibrate --format json
description: Output of `ynh check --calibrate --format json`. Runs each sensor against its declared reference fixture and reports whether it still observes what it claims to. A separate mode from `ynh check`: a gate that calibrates on every invocation is a gate people disable. Exit code 0 = every sensor with a reference behaved as declared, 1 = at least one did not, 2 = ynh could not run the calibration.

capabilities.description: Wire-protocol version. See CLAUDE.md capability-bump rule.

verdict.description: broken when any sensor failed calibration or could not be calibrated at all. Uncalibrated sensors alone never make a run broken — a gap is not a failure.

summary.description: Counts per outcome. uncalibrated is reported rather than hidden: how much of a gate is proven to observe is itself a useful number.

kind.description: command, files or focus. Only a command sensor can be calibrated: calibration compares an exit code against a declared expectation, and neither a files nor a focus source produces one.

status.description: calibrated: the reference produced the declared result. failed: it produced the wrong one — for an `expect: fail` fixture, the sensor did not flag something it was built to flag. uncalibrated: no reference declared; a gap, not a failure. error: the reference could not be run, which needs a different remedy from a wrong answer.

reference.description: Fixture path, relative to the harness. Absent when none is declared.

observed.description: Absent when the reference could not be run.

note.description: Why, in plain language, when the status is failed or error.
